newsitem.title: USA: Bethune, Laker to speak at Latam air conference.
newsitem.headline: Bethune, Laker to speak at Latam air conference.

text.p: Gordon Bethune, chief executive of Continental Airlines Inc, and Freddie Laker, founder of Britain's Laker Airways, will speak at a Latin American airline chief executive conference that begins Sunday.
The meeting is organized by well-known consultant Robert C. Booth and his firm Aviation Management Services Inc.
At least 30 airline chief executives are expected and more than 40 airlines will be represented, according to Booth's company.

More than 300 airline industry, government aviation authority and other executives are expected to attend the "Globalization Hit or Myth" conference at the Sonesta Beach Hotel on Miami's Key Biscayne.
The controversial trend of alliances between airlines, alternatives to Miami International Airport and open skies in Mercosur are a few of the topics to be discussed.
Joseph McCarty, Federal Express Corp senior vice president, Latin America and Caribbean Division, will speak on the future of cargo in the Americas.

Chief executives scheduled to participate in panel discussions include Manuel Moran of Aerolineas Argentinas, Federico Bloch of the TACA group of airlines in Central America, Juan Emilio Posada of ACES (Aerolineas Centrales do Colombia SA) and Gilles Filliatreault of BWIA International Airlines, Port of Spain, Trinidad.
